dedupe_keys.name: irth asset integrity for pipelines aip saas platform

description: Irth Solutions offers a software-as-a-service platform for energy, utility and telecom networks; its Asset Integrity for Pipelines (AIP) modules manage the data behind pipeline integrity programmes. Contents: inline inspection (ILI) data management and analysis, internal and external corrosion programmes, crack assessment with pressure-cycle fatigue and failure analyses, quantitative risk management driven by inspection data, and geohazard management; related modules handle 811 dig-ticket management and damage prevention, and land, right-of-way and stakeholder management. A case study says Enbridge automated pipeline crossing reviews with AIP, cutting review times from hours to minutes. Coverage: pipeline, utility and telecom operators. Format and access: a hosted web service sold to operators. Licence and cost: proprietary; price on request. Caveats: vendor page only; no public data. It organises inspection, corrosion and geohazard data that feed hazard exposure and resilience models of oil and gas pipelines, including third-party damage risk. It relates to the Mistras pipeline integrity software and the PHMSA incident data in the catalogue.
